scope: Additive TH18 regular Barbarian L1-L13 direct-parent baseline.
game_version: Goblins Farm reports client build 18.600.3 for the current parent table; corroborating secondary pages do not publish a client build.

sources.title: The Sound of Clash Update
sources.limitations: Confirms permanent TH18 Barbarian level 13 availability but not its values, targeting, pathing, collision or timing.

sources.title: Barbarian — Clash of Clans
sources.limitations: Reports current L1-L13 HP/DPS, one housing, ground targeting, one-second cadence, no preferred target and nearest-building behavior. It calls range melee but does not quantify range, path topology, collision, tie or fixed-tick ordering.

sources.title: Barbarian
sources.limitations: Corroborates L1-L13 values, one housing, speed 18, one-second cadence, ground-only melee, no preference and 0.4-tile range. No client build or deterministic path/collision contract is published.

support.note: The L1-L13 ground parent and no-preference nearest-building path use shared Core targeting; Headless, Viewer and RL consume that immutable GameData route.

changed_values.previous_state: Catalogued-only direct parent despite an official TH18 L13 release and frozen/secondary parent table.
changed_values.replacement: The existing shared Core no-preference melee route is explicitly validated for L13 through focused Core, snapshot/replay and Headless CLI coverage.
changed_values.justification: Primary evidence establishes TH18 L13 and current secondary sources agree on its direct parent contract. No route, collision or timing rule is added.

known_uncertainties: No consulted source defines Barbarian route topology, collision, target hitbox, attack wind-up, target loss, same-tick retarget ordering, target ties or visual animation timing.
The nearest-target wording does not define geometric metric or candidate ordering; Core distance then entity-ID tie breaking is a deterministic simulator rule, not asserted as client fidelity.
Exact current values and the 0.4-tile range are secondary; the official release note does not publish quantitative parent data.
conclusion: Barbarian L1-L13 is executable through shared Core, Headless, Viewer and RL as a ground no-preference melee parent. Route, collision, target ties, timing and visual fidelity remain partial.
